integrity: Exact integer/string computations with a complete adjacent-LCP-core candidate lemma; standalone reproducible checker and output digests are supplied. No external or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact exhaustive classification only for ten finite dyadic words R_m, 7 <= m <= 16; neither unbounded m nor an infinite-word formula is established. Potential unindexed equivalent lists are a residual literature risk.
title: Exact finite antidictionary spectra of Rudin–Shapiro dyadic prefixes
